title: Rationalization
description: Offering false or inauthentic excuses for our claim because we know the real reasons are much less persuasive or more embarrassing to share, or harsher than the manufactured ones given.
logical_form: Reason A is given for claim B, although reason A is not the real reason.

examples.example: I can’t go with you to that opera because I have a deadline at work coming up, plus I need to wash my hair that night.
examples.explanation: The real reason is, “I don’t want to go”, but that might hurt some feelings, so manufactured reasons (excuses) are given in place of the authentic and honest reason.

examples.example: I believe in winged horses because the Koran is historically accurate and would never get such an important fact wrong.
examples.explanation: The person actually believes in winged horses out of *faith*, but recognizes that is not a persuasive argument -- especially to the non-believer of Islam.  Out of the desire to hold on to his faith, he adopts a common defense (historical accuracy) and gives that as the reason.

exceptions: Is it acceptable to rationalize to protect someone’s feelings?  I will leave that to you to answer, realizing that all situations are unique.
tips: Whenever possible, give honest reasons stated in diplomatic ways.
references: Fallacies | Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy. (n.d.). Retrieved from http://www.iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Rationalization
description_et: Väidetele valede või ebaautentsete vabanduste pakkumine, sest me teame, et tegelikud põhjused on palju vähem veenvad või piinlikumad jagada või karmimad kui väidetavad.
logical_form_et: Põhjus A on toodud väitele B, kuigi põhjus A ei ole tegelik põhjus.
exceptions_et: Kas on vastuvõetav ratsionaliseerimine, et kaitsta kellegi tundeid?  Jätan selle vastamise teile, mõistes, et kõik olukorrad on ainulaadsed.
tips_et: Kui vähegi võimalik, põhjendage seda diplomaatilisel viisil.

examples_et.example: Ma ei saa sinuga sellesse ooperisse kaasa minna, sest mul on tööl tähtaeg tulemas, lisaks pean sel õhtul juukseid pesema.
examples_et.explanation: Tegelik põhjus on "ma ei taha minna", kuid see võib teatud tundeid riivata, nii et autentse ja ausa põhjuse asemel esitatakse väljamõeldud põhjused (vabandused).
examples_et.original_example: I can’t go with you to that opera because I have a deadline at work coming up, plus I need to wash my hair that night.
examples_et.original_explanation: The real reason is, “I don’t want to go”, but that might hurt some feelings, so manufactured reasons (excuses) are given in place of the authentic and honest reason.

examples_et.example: Usun tiivulistesse hobustesse, sest Koraan on ajalooliselt täpne ega eksiks kunagi nii olulist fakti valesti.
examples_et.explanation: Inimene usub tiivulistesse hobustesse tegelikult *usust*, kuid mõistab, et see ei ole veenev argument – ​​eriti islamiusku mitteusklike jaoks.  Soovist oma usku kinni hoida, võtab ta omaks ühise kaitse (ajaloolise täpsuse) ja põhjendab seda.
